documentation.content: More than 500 questions were handled in an hour. At the measured 0.0002 USD each that is about 0.10 USD an hour, which is far above what a demo should see, so it usually means the shared API key is being used heavily or automatically. The OpenAI account's hard monthly limit still caps the total spend; this is the early warning. Volume is used rather than summed cost because Cloud Monitoring cannot compare a distribution metric, such as cost per question, against a threshold.
